_doc: Knowledge Plane — agent context. Meaning + routing only; fields live in the Malloy models (compile the named source). If a term is not a concept here it is not a governed metric: you may explore the raw data with small inline queries, but label any such result as ungoverned and never present it as an official metric.

concepts.label: Calendar Date
concepts.definition: A single calendar day, used as the temporal anchor for transactions and reporting periods.

concepts.label: Currency Exchange Rate
concepts.definition: The daily rate for converting an amount from one currency into a reporting currency.

concepts.label: Customer
concepts.definition: A natural or legal person who buys products from the company.

concepts.label: Order
concepts.definition: A purchase transaction placed by a customer at a store on a given date, composed of one or more order lines.

concepts.label: Order Line
concepts.definition: A single line on an order, recording one product, its quantity and the prices applied at sale time.

concepts.label: Product
concepts.definition: A sellable item offered to customers, identified by a stable product key.

concepts.label: Store
concepts.definition: A physical or online point of sale where orders are placed.

concepts.label: Active Customer
concepts.definition: A customer with at least one order in the last 2 years.

concepts.label: Active Store Count
concepts.definition: Number of stores in scope that are not closed.

concepts.label: Average Exchange Rate
concepts.definition: Average currency exchange rate applied to convert order lines into the reporting currency.

concepts.label: Average Order Value
concepts.definition: Average revenue per order: total sales divided by order count.

concepts.label: Average Selling Price
concepts.definition: Net sales divided by units sold; the average realized price per unit. (ASP)

concepts.label: Average Delivery Days
concepts.definition: Average number of days between order date and delivery date across orders in scope.

concepts.label: Delivered Within 3 Days Rate
concepts.definition: Share of orders in scope delivered within three days of the order date.

concepts.label: Discount Amount
concepts.definition: Total discount given: gross (list) revenue minus net sales, in the reporting currency.

concepts.label: Discount Rate
concepts.definition: Discount amount as a share of gross (list) revenue.

concepts.label: Distinct Products Sold
concepts.definition: Number of distinct products that appear on at least one order line in scope.

concepts.label: Gross Revenue
concepts.definition: Total revenue valued at list price, before discounts, in the reporting currency.

concepts.label: Line Cost
concepts.definition: Cost of goods sold for one order line: quantity times unit cost.

concepts.label: Line Count
concepts.definition: Number of order lines in scope.

concepts.label: Line Discount
concepts.definition: Discount given on one order line: quantity times (list price minus net price).

concepts.label: Line List Revenue
concepts.definition: Revenue for one order line valued at list price (before discount): quantity times unit list price.

concepts.label: Line Revenue
concepts.definition: Gross revenue for one order line: quantity times net price.

concepts.label: List Price Margin Percent
concepts.definition: Average catalog margin of products: (list price minus unit cost) divided by list price.

concepts.label: Margin
concepts.definition: Gross margin: total sales minus total cost.

concepts.label: Margin Percent
concepts.definition: Gross margin expressed as a ratio of total sales.

concepts.label: Markup Percent
concepts.definition: Gross margin expressed as a share of cost of goods sold: margin divided by total cost.

concepts.label: Order Count
concepts.definition: Number of distinct orders in scope.

concepts.label: Sales Per Square Meter
concepts.definition: Total sales divided by total store selling area, a retail productivity measure.

concepts.label: Store Count
concepts.definition: Number of distinct stores in scope.

concepts.label: Total Cost
concepts.definition: Sum of line cost across all order lines in scope.

concepts.label: Total Sales
concepts.definition: Sum of line revenue across all order lines in scope.

concepts.label: Total Units
concepts.definition: Total number of product units sold across all order lines in scope.

concepts.label: Units Per Order
concepts.definition: Average number of product units per order: total units divided by order count.

concepts.label: Customer Age
concepts.definition: Age of the customer in years.

concepts.label: Customer City
concepts.definition: City of residence of the customer.

concepts.label: Customer Country
concepts.definition: Country of residence of the customer.

concepts.label: Customer Gender
concepts.definition: Gender of the customer.

concepts.label: Customer Occupation
concepts.definition: Stated occupation of the customer.

concepts.label: Delivery Days
concepts.definition: Number of days between the order date and the delivery date for an order.

concepts.label: Line Quantity
concepts.definition: Number of product units on the order line.

concepts.label: Order Currency
concepts.definition: The original transaction currency in which an order was placed.

concepts.label: Order Date
concepts.definition: The calendar date on which the order was placed.

concepts.label: Product Brand
concepts.definition: Brand under which the product is sold.

concepts.label: Product Category
concepts.definition: Top-level merchandising category of the product.

concepts.label: Product Color
concepts.definition: Color the product is sold in.

concepts.label: Product Manufacturer
concepts.definition: Manufacturer that produces the product.

concepts.label: Product Sub-Category
concepts.definition: Merchandising sub-category of the product, below its top-level category.

concepts.label: Product Unit Cost
concepts.definition: Cost to the company of one unit of the product.

concepts.label: Product Unit Price
concepts.definition: List selling price of one unit of the product.

concepts.label: Sales Channel
concepts.definition: The channel through which an order was placed: Online or Physical store.

concepts.label: Store Country
concepts.definition: Country in which the store operates.

concepts.label: Store Open Date
concepts.definition: The date on which a store opened for business.

concepts.label: Store Square Meters
concepts.definition: Selling floor area of a store, in square meters.

concepts.label: Store Status
concepts.definition: Operating status of a store, e.g. open or closed.
